title: Local lifting of finite linear systems in a directed module-sheaf colimit
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on its open subsets. Work in the category $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set, let $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{ji}:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_j)_{i\le j}$ be a diagram, and let $(\mathcal F,(c_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F)_i)$ be a colimit cocone in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix an open $W\subseteq X$, integers $m,n\ge0$, coefficients $a_{kr}\in\mathcal O(W)$ for $1\le k\le m$, $1\le r\le n$, and sections $s_r\in\mathcal F(W)$ such that $\sum_{r=1}^n a_{kr}s_r=0$ for every $k$. For every $x\in W$ there are an open neighbourhood $x\in V\subseteq W$, an index $i\in I$, and sections $t_r\in\mathcal F_i(V)$ with $c_{i,V}(t_r)=s_r|_V$ for every $r$ and $\sum_{r=1}^n(a_{kr}|_V)t_r=0$ in $\mathcal F_i(V)$ for every $k$. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, quasi-coherence, or injectivity of the transition maps is assumed.

proof.text: Write $|\mathcal F_i|$ for the underlying set sheaves and put $P(U)=\varinjlim_i|\mathcal F_i(U)|$, with induced restriction maps and coprojections $p_{i,U}$. The directed preorder $I$ is filtered: it is nonempty, two indices have a common upper bound, and parallel arrows coincide. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-directed-colimit-underlying-sets], $(|\mathcal F|,(|c_i|)_i)$ is a colimit of these set sheaves. By [lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-colimit-sheafification], their colimit is also $P^\#$ with legs $\eta p_i$. The colimit universal property [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] gives a unique isomorphism $\alpha:P^\#\xrightarrow{\sim}|\mathcal F|$ with $\alpha\eta p_i=|c_i|$. Indeed the comparison maps in both directions compose to the identity since they agree with it on every cocone leg. Thus local statements about $\eta p_i$ apply to the specified maps $c_i$.

Fix $x\in W$. For each $r$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] to $\alpha^{-1}(s_r)\in P^\#(W)$ and choose a member $U_r$ of its open cover containing $x$. There is $q_r\in P(U_r)$ with $\alpha\eta(q_r)=s_r|_{U_r}$. By clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise], choose $i_r$ and $u_r\in\mathcal F_{i_r}(U_r)$ with $p_{i_r,U_r}(u_r)=q_r$. Consequently $c_{i_r}(u_r)=s_r|_{U_r}$. These are individual local lifts; no common cover or common stage is being assumed.

Let $U=\bigcap_{r=1}^nU_r$, taking $U=W$ if $n=0$. This is an open neighbourhood of $x$. Choose $i$ above all $i_r$: start with any index of the nonempty $I$ and successively replace it by an upper bound with each $i_r$. Put $u_r^0=\varphi_{i i_r,U}(u_r|_U)$. Naturality of $c_{i_r}$ and the cocone identity $c_i\varphi_{i i_r}=c_{i_r}$ give $c_i(u_r^0)=s_r|_U$. For each $k$ put $e_k=\sum_r(a_{kr}|_U)u_r^0\in\mathcal F_i(U)$. Sectionwise linearity gives $c_i(e_k)=\sum_r(a_{kr}|_U)(s_r|_U)=(\sum_r a_{kr}s_r)|_U=0$. These identities use exactly the linearity and restriction laws in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the cocone equations in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: For each $k$, the elements $p_{i,U}(e_k)$ and $p_{i,U}(0)$ have equal images in $P^\#(U)$, since their images under $\alpha$ are both zero. The last assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] gives an open cover on which they are equal in $P$; choose $V_k\subseteq U$ containing $x$ from that cover. Restriction compatibility of $p_i$ gives $p_{i,V_k}(e_k|_{V_k})=p_{i,V_k}(0)$. Apply clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] to the set diagram $j\mapsto|\mathcal F_j(V_k)|$. It gives $j_k\ge i$ with $\varphi_{j_k i,V_k}(e_k|_{V_k})=\varphi_{j_k i,V_k}(0)=0$. In the last equality a module homomorphism sends zero to zero [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The neighbourhood and the later index may depend on $k$.

proof.text: Let $V=\bigcap_{k=1}^mV_k$, taking $V=U$ if $m=0$, and choose $j\ge i,j_1,\ldots,j_m$ by successive binary upper bounds starting at $i$. Define $t_r=\varphi_{ji,V}(u_r^0|_V)$. The restriction and linearity laws [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] yield $\sum_r(a_{kr}|_V)t_r=\varphi_{ji,V}(e_k|_V)=\varphi_{j j_k,V}((\varphi_{j_k i,V_k}(e_k|_{V_k}))|_V)=0$ for every $k$. The cocone law [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] likewise gives $c_j(t_r)=c_i(u_r^0)|_V=s_r|_V$. This proves the result with index $j$. If $n=0$, the tuple is empty and all sums are zero; if $m=0$, no shrinking or advancement for relations is required. In both cases the choices above still exist. If $W$ is empty, there is no $x$ to consider.
